capability_gate.capability: Modify Python, PowerShell, CMD, tests and Windows packaging on an isolated branch
Run Linux and Windows source/runtime checks in GitHub Actions
Build and retrieve a Windows installer EXE from the exact validated head
Perform the physical user path on Dmitry's Windows computer

requirements.protocol_requirement: Legacy binary XLS files containing passive BIFF workbook data must be accepted and table rows extracted without relying on Microsoft Excel or guessing semantics.
requirements.action: Add a pinned offline XLS reader, content-first OLE/BIFF detection, bounded workbook extraction and explicit unsupported/security diagnostics.
requirements.test: Synthetic multi-sheet XLS, renamed-extension XLS, corrupt OLE, encrypted/unsupported XLS and formula-result cases on Linux and Windows.
requirements.artifact: source adapter, pinned dependency, XLS corpus and exact-head test evidence
requirements.pass_criterion: Passive XLS tables are extracted; malformed, encrypted or non-workbook OLE is rejected with typed diagnostics; no macro execution and no semantic fabrication.

requirements.protocol_requirement: Any file must be registered safely; supported tabular formats and nested archives must be detected by content rather than filename, while unsupported 7Z/RAR remain stored with explicit adapter limitations instead of a generic error.
requirements.action: Preserve safe registration, content detection, archive limits and explicit partial/unsupported reporting for ZIP, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, 7Z and RAR.
requirements.test: Renamed CSV/JSON/XML/XLS/XLSX, nested safe archives, active-content archive, corrupt archive, 7Z and RAR signatures.
requirements.artifact: universal intake/extraction reports and corpus evidence
requirements.pass_criterion: No safe file disappears or returns an untyped crash; extracted data is reported where supported and unsupported adapters are explicit and non-destructive.

requirements.protocol_requirement: Calculations must use the maximum verified data available, never invent missing fields, and expose partial coverage plus missing inputs.
requirements.action: Retain partial-calculation coverage and missing-field diagnostics through XLS and universal-table paths.
requirements.test: Partial known columns, unknown headers, mixed archive members and missing required finance-profile fields.
requirements.artifact: partial calculation JSON and missing-field evidence
requirements.pass_criterion: Verified metrics are calculated; unavailable metrics remain null/not-calculated with precise reason codes; no guessed values.

requirements.protocol_requirement: The installed START_QUANTUM.cmd must launch installed mode directly and must not force package installation on every subsequent run.
requirements.action: Remove forced PackageRoot from the installed launcher and let one_click_home_local.ps1 resolve complete installed layout.
requirements.test: Clean install followed by two sequential START_QUANTUM.cmd launches with installer invocation tracing.
requirements.pass_criterion: First and second installed launches execute the installed runtime without reinstalling or requiring package files.

requirements.protocol_requirement: START_QUANTUM.cmd must forward all command-line arguments exactly enough for diagnostic and noninteractive launch modes.
requirements.action: Forward %* after the PowerShell launcher invocation and add quoted-path tests.
requirements.test: Installed path with spaces and Cyrillic; -InstallOnly, -NoOpenResult and additional test arguments.
requirements.pass_criterion: Forwarded switches reach one_click_home_local.ps1 and control execution as requested.

requirements.protocol_requirement: The desktop shortcut must be created and verified reliably on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7, including Cyrillic user-facing naming where supported.
requirements.action: Eliminate code-page corruption at the powershell.exe boundary and add a deterministic ASCII fallback only when the Unicode path cannot be represented by the host.
requirements.test: Windows Server clean install under powershell.exe 5.1 and pwsh 7; COM readback of target, working directory and arguments.
requirements.pass_criterion: At least one verified shortcut exists, targets START_QUANTUM.cmd, has the correct working directory and no stale arguments; stale user/common shortcuts are removed or replaced.

requirements.protocol_requirement: Repair or upgrade must preserve config, data and output while replacing managed runtime and launcher files.
requirements.action: Retain transactional install/rollback and verify user sentinels through repeated installation.
requirements.test: Install twice with hashed sentinels in config, data and output plus injected managed-file replacement.
requirements.pass_criterion: All user sentinel hashes remain identical and managed files update atomically.

requirements.protocol_requirement: An incomplete installed tree must fail closed with an actionable repair diagnostic rather than silently reinstalling, hanging or opening a partial GUI.
requirements.action: Keep explicit HOME_LOCAL_INSTALLATION_INCOMPLETE detection and test it from direct PS1 and CMD paths.
requirements.test: Remove required installed components and launch both entry points.
requirements.pass_criterion: Nonzero exit and HOME_LOCAL_INSTALLATION_INCOMPLETE are emitted; no partial runtime starts.

requirements.protocol_requirement: Repeated imports and launches must never overwrite a previous output because two operations occurred within the same second.
requirements.action: Use collision-resistant output names and no-overwrite creation for PowerShell and Python launch surfaces.
requirements.test: Two and twenty rapid consecutive imports into the same output directory.
requirements.pass_criterion: Every successful run publishes a distinct file and an existing result is never overwritten.

requirements.protocol_requirement: The SLR1 Windows validation must test product behavior rather than fail while constructing an invalid stale shortcut fixture.
requirements.action: Replace the invalid .ps1 shortcut target fixture with a valid stale powershell.exe shortcut and stale arguments, then verify installer replacement.
requirements.test: Exact SLR1 clean-install/repair workflow on Windows 2025.
requirements.pass_criterion: Fixture construction succeeds and all clean install, repeat launch, shortcut repair, preservation and fail-closed checks execute.

requirements.protocol_requirement: All applicable source, security, performance, packaging and installed-runtime regressions must pass on one exact implementation head; historical ancestry-only workflows must be classified separately and not hidden.
requirements.action: Run focused Linux/Windows tests, complete source CI, Foundation, OSS, M4, M5 product regressions, M7, M8, L4, M3 and Native Red Team; document N/A construction gates explicitly.
requirements.test: Exact-head GitHub Actions matrix and artifact postchecks.
requirements.artifact: workflow runs, logs and hashes bound to one SHA
requirements.pass_criterion: Every applicable product/runtime gate is successful; any red product gate blocks the installer claim.

requirements.protocol_requirement: Create a new Windows installer EXE from the same validated implementation head and provide its identity without claiming physical user success.
requirements.action: Build bundle and EXE, verify embedded source commit, payload hashes, WB_ONLY scope, writes disabled and native self-test, then retrieve the EXE artifact.
requirements.test: Exact-head installer workflow, archive verification and native EXE self-test.
requirements.artifact: Quantum_WB_Offline_Setup.exe plus SHA-256 and workflow digest
requirements.pass_criterion: EXE is built from the exact validated head and passes packaged/native self-tests; physical L5 remains NOT_STARTED until Dmitry installs and launches it.

rollback_condition: Any focused or complete regression failure, manifest mismatch, unsafe XLS behavior, user-data mutation, launcher reinstall loop or package identity mismatch rejects the implementation head and leaves the immutable base unchanged.
